subject: How to get column value from tableoutput

messages.author: 544b331affe7cb21
messages.subject: How to get column value from tableoutput
parts:
I have created a table that contains numeric inputs with the following code:
numValues <- reactive({
  data.frame(
    Parameter = c("CLt", 
                  "Vc",
                  "CLd",
                  "Vp",
                  "Kin",
                  "IC50",
                  "IC1",
                  "IC2",
                  "IC3"),
    Values = c(paste0("<input id='a", 1:1, "' class='shiny-bound-input' type='number' value='6' min='0' max='100' step='.1' style='width: 100px;'>"),
                paste0("<input id='Vc", 2:2, "' class='shiny-bound-input' type='number' value='30' min='0' max='100' step='.1' style='width: 100px;'>"),
                paste0("<input id='CLd", 3:3, "' class='shiny-bound-input' type='number' value='12' min='0' max='100' step='.1' style='width: 100px;'>"),
                paste0("<input id='Vp", 4:4, "' class='shiny-bound-input' type='number' value='60' min='0' max='100' step='.1' style='width: 100px;'>"),
                paste0("<input id='Kin", 5:5, "' class='shiny-bound-input' type='number' value='20' min='0' max='100' step='.1' style='width: 100px;'>"),
                paste0("<input id='IC50", 6:6, "' class='shiny-bound-input' type='number' value='.5' min='0' max='5' step='.01' style='width: 100px;'>"),
                paste0("<input id='IC1", 7:7, "' class='shiny-bound-input' type='number' value='0' min='0' max='5' step='.1' style='width: 100px;'>"),
                paste0("<input id='IC2", 8:8, "' class='shiny-bound-input' type='number' value='0' min='0' max='5' step='.01' style='width: 100px;'>"),
                paste0("<input id='IC3", 9:9, "' class='shiny-bound-input' type='number' value='100' min='0' max='150' step='.1' style='width: 100px;'>")),
    stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}) 

output$values <- renderTable({
  numValues()
}, sanitize.text.function = function(x) x)

When I do tableOutput("values") it displays just fine. I am wondering how I can get a vector that contains just the numeric input column of my table.  
So far I have tried input id and directly using Values from the dataframe. input$a, input$Vc,input$CLd.... does not return anything and when I use Values I get the direct code I typed.
